text:
emily_park: Customer (HealthGrid) wants an air-gapped pilot. Requirements: USB-delivered artifacts, small incremental updates (not full images each time), manifest + signature verification, and a clear upgrade cadence for procurement. They also need per-site offline support pricing and an example acceptance checklist for their audits.

ranjit_singh: We can do chunked delta bundles + signed manifests. Notes: delta format depends on model shard layout; some large quantized shards may not delta efficiently and would require full replacement. Agent requirement: >=2.4.2 for offline delta apply.

diana_ops: Operational notes:
- apply command: `redwood-offline-apply --manifest /media/usb/manifest.json --verify --check-sbom`
- we support verifying signatures against either our certificate or a customer-provided root cert (PEM).
- delivery options: USB stick, signed ISO, or encrypted tarball. Provide checksum file and manifest.

eng-sales-bot: Created POC ticket POC-9933 assigned to ranjit_singh. Link: https://app.redwood/POC-9933

ranjit_singh: Example manifest snippet (for demo only):
```
{"manifest_version":"1.0","site":"healthgrid-alpha","bundles":["runtime-3.1.zst","models/sm-gptq-v1"],"delta":true,"sig":"MEUCIQ..."}
```

diana_ops: Cadence recommendation: default quarterly deltas (included in baseline offline plan). Monthly cadence available as an SLA addon; hotfixes (ad-hoc) can be requested and priced per-event. We require scheduled maintenance windows and customer approval before applying any bundle.

emily_park: Pricing sketch for sales: baseline offline package = $16k/yr/site (signed packaging, 1 quarterly delta, manifest verification tooling). Monthly delta plan = $24k/yr/site. Per hotfix (ad-hoc) = $3k/event. Travel/onsite support billed T&M.

security_maya: Security checklist we need returned pre-SOW: preferred root-CA exchange method, SBOM acceptance & format, whether customer wants us to sign with on-prem HSM or they will supply signed manifests, retention and telemetry opt-out, and SOC/ISO evidence requests. I will prepare a short questionnaire.

emily_park: Plan: Kickoff demo Thurs 11am PT. Agenda: walkthrough of manifest flow, demo `redwood-offline-apply` with a signed delta on a VM (no internet), discuss cadence options and pricing, review security checklist. Ranji, can you produce a signed demo delta and README for USB drop by Wed EOD?

ranjit_singh: Yes. I'll create a small signed delta, checksums, and bring-your-media steps. Uploading to staging bucket and will share link+sha256 before the call.

diana_ops: I'll draft an acceptance checklist for them (post-install verification steps, rollback instructions, and audit artifacts to collect).

emily_park: Great. If HealthGrid can provide their root cert ahead of time we can demo verification end-to-end. :thumbsup:
